disorder-name.detail: Pediatric relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS). All 68 patients met diagnostic criteria for RRMS. Clinical cohort enrolled at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR), Milan.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Sixty-eight right-handed pediatric patients with relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS) were enrolled and underwent baseline clinical and MRI evaluation."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohort of 68 pediatric RRMS patients recruited at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR), Milan, Italy. No named public dataset; single-site clinical recruitment.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Sixty-eight right-handed pediatric patients with relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS) were enrolled and underwent baseline clinical and MRI evaluation." ... "a group of 26 sex- and age-matched HC recruited at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR)"

age.detail: Mean age and SD for the whole group of pediatric patients with MS (n=68) at baseline. Min/max not explicitly reported.
